name: xp
comment: Windows XP SP3 x86. Header 5.1. 'missing' lists kernel32 funcs absent on XP that the shim currently polyfills. Functions absent on XP but not yet polyfilled are in 'pending' (informational; add to 'missing' once a polyfill exists in GO2XPTBL). Source: MS Learn 'Minimum supported client' + go-legacy-winxp; verify against a live XP export dump before release (SPEC 7.1).

overrides.comment: present on XP but wrapped anyway; served from the shim table ahead of the real export (see go2xp_overrides in shim)

pending.comment: absent on XP SP3 and requested by f4 (lazily), but deliberately left to fail: Go or f4 handles the error, or there is no XP equivalent
